selection_criteria: Early-window decisions + credit-driven purchases (where both moats compound)

verticals.name: Big-Box Home Improvement
verticals.rationale: Existing 38% AOV proof point. Expand from reference customer to direct competitors and adjacent specialty home-improvement retail.

verticals.name: Home Furnishings & Appliances
verticals.rationale: Move triggers furniture, mattress, and appliance purchases; credit-qualified filter aligns with financed AOV.

verticals.name: Home Services Franchises
verticals.rationale: New movers are peak buyers for moving, cleaning, lawn, pest, handyman in first 6-8 weeks. Sell at HQ; franchisees consume on top.
verticals.sales_motion: HQ enterprise deal with franchisee pull-through

verticals.name: Insurance Agency Networks
verticals.rationale: Movers shop home/auto policies; agency networks capture at HQ and distribute to regional clusters.

verticals.name: Mortgage Refi & Home Equity
verticals.rationale: Homeowner-flagged records compound with credit-qualified filter. Refi/HELOC value early identification.

verticals.name: Security / Alarm
verticals.rationale: Industry explicitly fights for the first-6-weeks window. First-contact moat is the entire pitch.

verticals.name: Solar / HVAC / Window Replacement
verticals.rationale: Long sales cycles; early identification of credit-qualified homeowners is high-value.
